File No: S. R. D. REGISTRY
No. S. R. D. 8155 (S)
40

Subject Efforts to build army by Wang Ching Wei.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

Enquiries confirm that about 1,000 military cadets completed their education in the Central Military Academy, Kiangwan, on February 20, after three months' training under General Yeh Poong and Japanese advisors.

These cadets will be put into service in the various parts of Japanese controlled areas where recruiting and conscription of men is being carried on. Vast numbers of able-bodied men have returned from Shanghai to the interior owing to the prevailing high cost of living which greatly reduces the difficulties of recruiting officers. However, it is believed that Shantung and Kwangtung are the best provinces to pick up good soldiers and roughly 100,000 will be required for the organization of an army. Although Wang Ching Wei's followers claim this army will be required to strengthen the position of his government and further as a means to replace the Japanese troops when they withdraw, yet it is feared that the men may be used for fighting against the Chungking forces under close supervision of the Japanese.

The formation of Wang Ching Wei's Central Government will probably again be postponed from March 15, the date originally scheduled, due to the fact that Liang Hung Tse, Chief of the Nanking Government, insists on the celebration of the 2nd anniversary of his government on March 28.

There remains other questions to be settled between Liang Hung Tse, Wang Keh Min and Wang Ching Wei.

主题：汪精卫组建军队的努力。

撰写人及报送人：谭绍良警司

经查询证实，约1,000名军校学员在叶蓬将军和日本顾问的指导下经过三个月的训练后，于2月20日在江湾中央军官学校结业。

这些学员将被派往正在开展征兵和募兵工作的日军控制区各地服役。由于生活成本高涨，大量身强力壮的男子从上海返回内地，这大大降低了招募军官的难度。然而，人们认为山东和广东是挑选优秀士兵的最佳省份，组建一支军队大约需要10万人。尽管汪精卫的追随者声称这支军队将用于加强其政府的地位，并作为日军撤退时的替代力量，但人们担心这些士兵会在日本的严密监视下被用于对抗重庆部队。

由于南京政府主席梁鸿志坚持要在3月28日庆祝其政府成立两周年，汪精卫中央政府的成立可能会再次从原定的3月15日推迟。

梁鸿志、王克敏和汪精卫之间仍有其他问题有待解决。

CHINA PRESS
FEB 22 1940

Frenzied Efforts To Build Army
By Wang Ching-wei Seen

Determined efforts on the part of Mr. Wang Ching-wei and his followers to raise an army by the end of March were revealed to THE CHINA PRESS yesterday, following reports that 525 Chinese officers had graduated from the "Central Military Academy" in the suburbs of Shanghai Tuesday evening.

Lack of military force, it was stated, was one of the major difficulties confronting an inauguration ceremony of the proposed "Central Government."

A strong army is needed not merely to add color to the inauguration ceremony, it was stated, but it is of vital necessity as a permanent force to uphold the prestige of the "Central Government" and to enforce its order.

Cannot Command Respect

Mr. Wang Ching-wei is fully aware of the fact that he cannot command the respect of the Chinese people, and even that of many of his followers, if he does not obtain the withdrawal of Japanese troops. Yet, if the Nipponese armies should withdraw, the plans for a "central regime" are likely to face an immediate collapse.

The formation of a strong "peace preservation corps," it was stated, was one of the major issues discussed by Mr. Wang Ching-wei and Mr. Liang Hung-chih, chief executive of the "Reformed Government," when the two officials met at Mr. Wang's Yu Yuen Road residence Monday night.

Made Statement

Following Mr. Wang's statements that the withdrawal of the Japanese forces was one of the major conditions on which the "Central Government" would be inaugurated, it would be impossible for the new regime to function in the face of the continued presence of Japanese troops, it was stated.

Doubt that the new "Central Government" would be inaugurated before the anniversary of the "Reformed Government" in Nanking was expressed by Mr. Liang Hung-chih on Monday.

According to his statement to the press, as reported by Domei, official Japanese news agency, Mr. Liang stated that "if the new 'Central Government' is established before the second anniversary of the organization of the 'Reformed Government' at Nanking, the latter will merely announce the transfer of its business to the former without celebrating the anniversary."

In revealing his views on this transfer, Mr. Liang appeared to have failed to sound a note of confidence that the Central Government would be inaugurated by March 28 next.

《大美晚报》
1940年2月22日

可见汪精卫疯狂 efforts 组建军队

继周二晚间有报道说525名中国军官从上海郊区的“中央军官学校”毕业后，《大美晚报》昨日获悉，汪精卫先生及其追随者正决心在3月底前组建一支军队。

据称，缺乏军事力量是拟议中的“中央政府”就职典礼面临的主要困难之一。

据称，建立一支强大的军队不仅是为了给就职典礼增色，更是作为维护“中央政府”威望和执行其命令的常备力量所 vital 必需的。

无法赢得尊重

汪精卫先生充分意识到这样一个事实：如果不能促使日军撤出，他就无法赢得中国人民的尊重，甚至无法赢得许多追随者的尊重。然而，如果日军撤出，“中央政权”的计划可能会立即崩溃。

据称，组建一支强大的“和平保全队”是汪精卫先生与“维新政府”行政院长梁鸿志周一晚在汪位于愚园路的寓所会晤时讨论的主要问题之一。

发表声明

继汪先生声明日军撤出是“中央政府”就职的主要条件之一后，据称，面对日军的持续存在，新政权将无法运作。

梁鸿志周一表示，怀疑新的“中央政府”能否在南京“维新政府”周年纪念日前就职。

据日本官方通讯社同盟社报道，梁先生在对新闻界的声明中表示：“如果新的‘中央政府’在南京‘维新政府’成立两周年之前建立，后者将仅宣布将其事务移交给前者，而不庆祝周年纪念。”

在透露他对这一移交的看法时，梁先生似乎未能流露出对中央政府将在明年3月28日前就职的信心。

FEB 2 2 1940
Fu May Be
Deprived Of
"Mayor" Post

That "Mayor" Fu Siao-en of the
"City Government of Greater
Shanghai" may be deprived of his
office in the near future was
strongly rumored in well-informed
circles yesterday.
It was stated that the
"mayor" berth may be filled by
Dr. Chu Ming-yi, secretary-
general of the "Orthodox Kuo-
mintang" and Mr. Wang Ching-
wei's brother-in-law.
Dr. Chu Ming-yi, it will be re-
called, recently went to Nanking
and returned with Mr. Liang
Hung-chih, head of the "Reformed
Government," February 19.
"Mayor" Fu officially assumed
office on October 16, 1938, re-
placing Mr. Soo Hsi-wen who,
despite his close relationship
with the Japanese, was not
considered as a man "capable
of inspiring the confidence of
the Chinese."
Sixty-eight years old, "Mayor"
Fu is a native of Chinhai, Che-
kiang. Before the establishment
of the National Government in
1937, he was considered as one of
the most influential merchants in
Kiangsu.
Was Leading Businessman
"Mayor" Fu was at one time
director and general manager of
the Commercial Bank of China,
director of the Ningpo Commercial
Bank, managing director of the
China Merchants' Steam Naviga-
tion Company and a number of
other leading industrial, banking
and commercial concerns.
A close associate of many of
China's old-time warlords, Mr.
Fu was particularly friendly
with Generals Wu Pei-fu and
Sun Chuan-fang, who at that
time controlled the Kiangsu-
Chekiang-Anhwei area.
When the Nationalist revolu-
tionary forces slashed their way
across the rich Yangtse Valley,
Mr. Fu foresaw the day when his
warlord friends would be dethron-
ed and, with their downfall, saw
his own exit. He arranged to aid
Sun Chuan-fang with money and
transport facilities which, as head
of the China Merchants' Steam
Navigation Company, he could
easily accomplish.
Backed Wrong Horse
As events turned out, Fu backed
the wrong horse. The Nationalist
Armies occupied Shanghai and the
supporter of the fallen warlords
fled to Dairen. An order was
issued for his arrest, and many of
his real estate and other holdings
were confiscated.
For a decade Mr. Fu Siao-en
lived in Dairen and Japan, and
returned for permanent resi-
dence here only after the out-
break of Sino-Japanese hostili-
ties in July, 1937, apparently
with a view to recouping his
losses.

1940年2月22日

傅筱庵或将被剥夺
“市长”职位

据消息灵通人士昨日强烈传言，“大上海市政府”“市长”傅筱庵可能在不久的将来被免职。

据悉，“市长”一职可能由“正统国民党”秘书长、汪精卫先生的妹夫朱明义（音译）博士接任。

回想起来，朱明义博士最近前往南京，并于2月19日与“维新政府”头目梁鸿志一同返回。

傅“市长”于1938年10月16日正式就职，接替苏锡文先生。尽管苏锡文与日本人关系密切，但他被认为不是一个“能赢得中国人信任”的人。

傅“市长”现年六十八岁，浙江镇海人。在1937年国民政府成立之前，他被认为是江苏最有影响力的商人之一。

曾是商界领袖

傅“市长”曾担任中国商业银行的董事兼总经理、宁波商业银行董事、招商局轮船公司常务董事，以及其他多家主要工业、银行和商业机构的职务。

傅先生与中国许多旧军阀关系密切，尤其与当时控制江浙皖地区的吴佩孚将军和孙传芳将军交好。

当国民革命军势如破竹地横扫富庶的长江流域时，傅先生预见到他的军阀朋友终将被推翻，而随着他们的倒台，他也看到了自己的末路。他安排向孙传芳提供资金和运输便利，作为招商局轮船公司的负责人，他很容易做到这一点。

押错宝

然而事态发展表明，傅先生押错了宝。国民革命军占领上海，这位已倒台军阀的支持者逃往大连。当局发布了逮捕令，他的许多房地产和其他资产被没收。

傅筱庵先生在大连和日本生活了十年，直到1937年7月中日敌对行动爆发后才返回此地永久居住，显然是为了弥补损失。

1940年2月22日

新中央银行将设于此

北平，2月20日电。
据此间中文报道，在汪精卫先生领导的新中央政府成立后，将建立一家新的中央银行，其总行将设在上海。

据报道，在新中央银行成立后，由于华北将处于特殊地位，联合准备银行和蒙疆银行的钞票将继续照常流通。

另有报道称，新中央银行将使联合准备银行和蒙疆银行成为其附属机构，并在它们需要时提供帮助。——路透社

CHINA PRESS.

2 2 1940

Outside Road Talks Held Up
As Nippon Adviser Absent

Originally scheduled to take place, preliminary negotiations over details in connection with the modus vivendi agreement between the S.M.C., and the "City Government of Greater Shanghai" on the Outside Roads issue have been postponed pending the return from Nanking of Colonel Igarashi, adviser to the "City Government Police Bureau," it was learned yesterday from Japanese sources.

Colonel Igarashi was to have been one of the officials present on behalf of the "City Government" in these negotiations, which were to have been opened today at a tea party given by "Mayor" Fu Siao-en. The Japanese adviser, however, has left for Nanking, and is due to return shortly.

Major K. M. Bourne, M.C., S.M.P. Commissioner, and Mr. C. Akagi, Special Deputy Commissioner of the S.M.P., were to

have headed the delegates of the Council at the negotiations, at which Mr. Lu Ying, chief of the "City Government Police Bureau," is to be present.

Meanwhile, skepticism with regard to the foreclosure of all gambling dens in the western district, officially set for March 1 next, was voiced in official circles yesterday.

While it is believed that the smaller dens may close down as announced, it is extremely doubted that several large-scale gambling houses, constructed on a lavish scale and involving the investment of hundreds of thousands, would comply with the order.

Because it may take as long as two months before the Special Police Force for the Outside Roads area is formed, however, it is hoped that all gambling houses will close upon the assumption of office of this new force.

（批：He has now returned to Shanghai. Jan 3/2.）

《字林西报》

1940年2月22日

因日本顾问缺席，越界筑路谈判搁置

据昨日从日本方面获悉，工部局与“大上海市政府”之间关于越界筑路问题的临时共存协议细节的初步谈判，原计划举行，现因“市政府警察局”顾问五十岚大佐从南京返回前而推迟。

五十岚大佐本应作为“市政府”的代表官员之一参加这些谈判，谈判原定于今日在傅筱庵“市长”举行的茶会上开始。然而，这位日本顾问已前往南京，预计不久后将返回。

工部局警务处总监 K. M. Bourne 少校（获军事十字勋章），以及工部局警务处特别副总监 C. Akagi 先生，本应率领工部局代表团参加谈判，“市政府警察局”局长陆英（音译）先生也将出席。

与此同时，官方人士昨日对定于明年3月1日正式关闭西区所有赌窟的计划表示怀疑。

虽然人们相信较小的赌窟可能会按宣布的那样关闭，但人们极度怀疑几家规模宏大、投资达数十万的豪华大型赌场会遵守该命令。

然而，由于组建越界筑路地区特别警察部队可能需要长达两个月的时间，因此希望在这支新部队上任后，所有赌场都能关闭。

（批注：他现已返回上海。1月3/2。）

pages.en:
FEB 20 1940

Messrs. Wang Ching-wei
And Liang Hung-chih In
Conference At Shanghai

Matters Of Importance Connected With Formation
Of New Central Government Discussed During
Yesterday Evening's Conversations

CIRCULATION OF HUA HSING BANK NOTES
DISCUSSED BY MR. LIANG HUNG-CHIH

Mr. Wang Ching-wei, Chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the orthodox Kuomintang, and Mr. Liang Hung-chih, chief executive of the Reformed Government, discussed matters believed to be important in connection with the projected establishment of the new Central Government of China, at 6 o'clock yesterday evening when the latter called on Mr. Wang at his residence on Yu Yuen Road.

Mr. Liang arrived here yesterday to attend a regular meeting of the Board of Directors of the Hua Hsing Commercial Bank. He will stay here for a few days before returning to Nanking. Following his arrival here, Mr. Liang received press representatives at the Hua Hsing Commercial Bank and commented on the situation in general in regard to the creation of a new Central Government of China and the future of the bank.

The projected new Central Government would come into existence shortly after the organization of the Central Political Council, which was expected in the near future, Mr. Liang stated.

If the new Central Government is established before the second anniversary of the organization of the Reformed Government at Nanking, the latter will merely announce the transfer of its business to the former without celebrating the anniversary, Mr. Liang said in the press interview.

"During the past two years since the establishment of the Reformed Government I have been merely performing my duty," Mr. Liang continued.

"I am glad to transfer to the new Central Government the business under our jurisdiction since the objective of the new central régime is in perfect accord with that of the Reformed Government, which is to rescue the Chinese masses from miseries following the Sino-Japanese hostilities and restore and maintain peace and order in the Japanese-occupied areas."

Hua Hsing Notes

With regard to the Hua Hsing Commercial Bank and its future, the Chief Executive of the Reformed Government stated that the circulation of Hua Hsing notes, the exchange rate of which was set at 6d., had not been satisfactory, but the Bank will undoubtedly overcome the present situation and attain successful results as it has enough reserve funds in foreign currency and conducts its business under a sound policy.

The Hua Hsing Commercial Bank was established as a purely commercial bank although it is connected with the Reformed Government at Nanking as far as its capital is concerned, Mr. Liang pointed out, adding that the Bank will be taken over by the projected new Central Government when it is established, but the Bank will have no direct connection with the new Central regime.

Central Bank Question

When questioned by a reporter about the possibility of establishing a new Central Bank under the new Central Government, Mr. Liang said: "Since the Tsingtao conference I have not been consulted with regard to economic and financial matters and am not in a position to comment on the question."

"Some suggest that the Hua Hsing Commercial Bank should be reorganized into a new Central Bank, but on the other hand it is worth considering that the Bank remains a commercial bank in parallel to a new Central Bank.

"The projected new Central Government is to be created to settle the losses and damages suffered by both the Japanese and Chinese Governments during the past two years of hostilities. In other words, the development of the projected new Central Government chiefly depends on how it will settle the questions pending between the two nations."

（批：Supt. Lam 20/2）

1940年2月20日

汪精卫与梁鸿志
在上海会晤

昨晚会谈讨论了与新中央政府组建有关的重要事项

梁鸿志先生讨论华兴银行钞票流通问题

“正统国民党”中央执行委员会主席汪精卫先生与“维新政府”行政院长梁鸿志先生，于昨晚6时在后者前往愚园路汪先生寓所拜访时，讨论了被认为与拟议中的中国新中央政府建立有关的重要事项。

梁先生昨抵此处，出席“华兴商业银行”董事会例行会议。他在返回南京前将在此停留数日。抵达此处后，梁先生在“华兴商业银行”接受了记者采访，并就创建中国新中央政府的总体形势及该行的未来发表了评论。

梁先生表示，拟议中的新中央政府将在中央政治委员会组织成立后不久问世，预计该委员会将于近期成立。

梁先生在接受记者采访时说，如果新中央政府在南京“维新政府”成立两周年之前成立，后者将仅宣布将其事务移交给前者，而不庆祝周年纪念。

“自‘维新政府’成立以来的过去两年里，我只是在履行我的职责，”梁先生继续说道。

“我很高兴将我们管辖下的事务移交给新中央政府，因为新政权的宗旨与‘维新政府’的宗旨完全一致，即把中国民众从中日敌对行动后的苦难中拯救出来，并在日军占领区恢复和维持和平与秩序。”

华兴钞票

关于“华兴商业银行”及其未来，“维新政府”行政院长表示，汇率定为6便士的华兴钞票流通情况并不令人满意，但该银行无疑将克服目前的局面并取得成功，因为它拥有足够的外汇储备金，并在健全的政策下开展业务。

梁先生指出，“华兴商业银行”是作为一家纯商业银行成立的，尽管就资本而言它与南京的“维新政府”有关联。他补充说，该行将在拟议中的新中央政府成立时被其接管，但该银行与新中央政权没有直接联系。

中央银行问题

当记者问及在新中央政府下建立新中央银行的可能性时，梁先生说：“自从青岛会议以来，我未就经济和财政事宜受到咨询，因此无权对此问题发表评论。”

“有人建议应将‘华兴商业银行’重组为新的中央银行，但另一方面，值得考虑的是，该行作为与新中央银行并行的商业银行保留下来。

“拟议中的新中央政府的建立，是为了解决过去两年敌对行动期间中日两国政府遭受的损失和损害。换句话说，拟议中的新中央政府的发展主要取决于它将如何解决两国之间悬而未决的问题。”

（批注：Lam 警司 2月20日）

《晚邮报》
1940年2月20日

汪精卫、梁鸿志在此举行会晤

梁氏称中央政权将接管南京政府职责

正统中国国民党中央执行委员会主席汪精卫先生，与维新政府行政院长梁鸿志先生，于昨晚六时就拟议中的中国新中央政府成立相关的重要事项进行了商讨，当时梁先生前往汪先生位于愚园路的寓所拜访。

梁先生昨日抵沪，出席华兴商业银行董事会例会。他将在沪停留数日后返回南京。

接见记者

梁先生抵沪后，在华兴商业银行接见了新闻界代表，并就建立中国新中央政府的总体形势以及该行的未来发表了评论。

梁先生表示，拟议中的新中央政府将在中央政治委员会组建后不久成立，预计该委员会将于近期成立。

梁先生在接受记者采访时称，如果新中央政府在新成立的维新政府两周年纪念日之前成立，后者将仅宣布将其事务移交给前者，而不举行周年庆祝活动。

履行职责

“自维新政府成立以来的过去两年里，我 merely 在履行我的职责，”梁先生继续说道。

“我很高兴将我们管辖范围内的事务移交给新中央政府，因为新政权的宗旨与维新政府的宗旨完全一致，即把中国民众从中日敌对行动带来的苦难中解救出来，并在日军占领区恢复和维持和平与秩序。”

关于华兴商业银行及其未来，维新政府行政院长表示，华兴银行钞票的流通情况并不令人满意，其汇率定为6便士，但该银行无疑将克服目前的局面并取得成功，因为它拥有足够的外汇储备，并在健全的政策下开展业务。

华兴银行

梁先生指出，华兴商业银行是作为一家纯商业银行成立的，尽管就资本而言，它与南京的维新政府有关联。他补充说，该行将在拟议中的新中央政府成立时由其接管，但该行与新中央政权没有直接联系。

当记者问及在新中央政府下建立一家新的中央银行的可能性时，梁先生说：“自青岛会议以来，无人就经济和财政事项征询我的意见，因此我无权对此问题发表评论。”

收到建议

“有人建议将华兴商业银行重组为一家新的中央银行，但另一方面，值得考虑的是，该行可作为一家商业银行，与新的中央银行并行存在。

“拟议中的新中央政府的成立，旨在解决过去两年敌对行动期间日本政府和中国政府所遭受的损失和损害。换言之，拟议中的新中央政府的发展主要取决于它将如何解决两国之间悬而未决的问题。”
